altTexts: The Inscribe workspace with the Text sub-tab selected and an empty content field
Text typed into the content field with the live quote updating
The fee selector with Normal, Fast, and Custom tiers
The receiver and payment sections showing the two-address model
The review or connect-prompt stage before any signature
The completed form state with every value shown before paying
stepInstructions: Open the inscribe workspace and select the Text sub-tab. The form shows content, receiver, and fee sections.
Type your message. The quote updates with the content size: network fee plus the 546 sat postage that stays yours.
Pick a fee tier. Normal is cheaper and slower; Fast pays more rate to confirm sooner.
Check the receiver section: the ordinals address holds the inscription while the payment address funds it. Both are yours.
Before any signature the app shows a review with the total to pay. This capture environment has no wallet connected, exactly like a first visit.
Final check: content, fee tier, quote total, and receiver all visible at once. Nothing is signed until you confirm in a wallet.
